mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dd_return_error(return_error_id, case_id, sequence_no, requirement_key, subject_party_id, error_code, reason, remediation_code, create_time) VALUES(#{row.returnErrorId}, #{row.caseId}, #{row.sequenceNo}, #{row.requirementKey}, #{row.subjectPartyId}, #{row.errorCode}, #{row.reason}, #{row.remediationCode}, #{row.createTime})
